description: Recommends ACE inhibitors, ARBs, or calcium channel blockers as first-line hypertension therapy rather than β‑adrenergic blockers in obese patients with type 2 diabetes. Triggers include when a clinician asks, 'What antihypertensive should I start for this obese patient with T2DM to avoid weight gain?' or 'Should I avoid β‑blockers in this patient with diabetes and hypertension?'
